name: comp-584
title: Simple Nav Header
description: A dark site header whose top row has a logo, a centered search field with a shortcut hint, a bell and an avatar, plus a second row of Home, Features, Pricing and About links.
use: A site wants a prominent search plus a secondary row of section links.
avoid: The nav strip hides on mobile, and the search shows a ⌘K hint that is never actually bound.
a11y: The search field has no label beyond its placeholder, the logo link is unnamed, and ⌘K is decorative only. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A two-row dark header: the top row has a starburst logo, a centered rounded search field with a magnifier and a small ⌘K hint, then a bell and avatar; a divider separates a second row of four nav links.
behaves: Typing fills the search field with a query and a native clear button. Nav links brighten on hover, and the bell drops a notifications panel from the top right that overlaps the link row.
customise: Search placeholder, nav labels, the active link and the ⌘K hint are written in the file; notification and user menus are separate pieces.
weight: light: Two rows of links, one input and two small menus.
